svg.aria-label: Fifteen selected systems by Gabriel Milkovich

g.text: 01 / LEGAL CALCULATION ENGINE
Production platform that turns dense legal and financial rules into deterministic, auditable calculation workflows.
Handles calculations, monetary updates, reports, history and parity checks against trusted reference outputs.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · SUPABASE · POSTGRESQL · DOMAIN MODELING · AUDITABILITY
02 / DOCUMENT-ASSISTED WORKFLOWS
AI-assisted document workflows that transform unstructured files into reviewed, structured and usable records.
Combines extraction, validation and human review so automation stays useful without hiding uncertainty.
TYPESCRIPT · NODE.JS · APPLIED AI · DATA EXTRACTION · HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP
03 / LEGAL ASSISTANT PLATFORM
Full-stack workspace for legal operations, connecting domain data, guided workflows and clear user decisions.
Designed around traceability, secure boundaries and interfaces that make complex processes easier to execute.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · NODE.JS · POSTGRESQL · SUPABASE · UX
04 / BUSINESS OPERATIONS HUB
Operational workspace that centralizes tasks, records, status changes and recurring business routines.
Replaces fragmented manual steps with consistent flows, searchable history and clear ownership.
JAVASCRIPT · NODE.JS · TYPESCRIPT · WORKFLOW DESIGN · AUTOMATION
05 / ANALYTICS & METRICS
Metrics layer for monitoring product behavior, operational volume and the signals that guide decisions.
Turns raw events into focused dashboards, comparable periods and actionable views for the business.
TYPESCRIPT · POSTGRESQL · SQL · DASHBOARDS · PRODUCT ANALYTICS
06 / AUTOMATED REPORTING
Reporting pipeline that generates consistent outputs from structured calculations and operational data.
Prioritizes readable documents, repeatable generation and a complete trail back to source values.
NODE.JS · TYPESCRIPT · SQL · DOCUMENT GENERATION · TRACEABILITY
07 / WORKFLOW AUTOMATION
Automation services for repetitive multi-step work, with explicit states, retries and operator feedback.
Connects application events and external services without turning business rules into hidden magic.
NODE.JS · TYPESCRIPT · APIS · INTEGRATIONS · OBSERVABILITY
08 / CALCULATION PARITY SUITE
Test harness that compares engine results with trusted cases across edge conditions and historical scenarios.
Makes discrepancies reproducible, measurable and safer to resolve before production delivery.
TYPESCRIPT · VITEST · PLAYWRIGHT · FIXTURES · REGRESSION TESTING
09 / SECURE DATA PLATFORM
Relational data foundation built for sensitive records, controlled access and durable business history.
Uses explicit schemas and permission boundaries so product speed does not trade away data integrity.
POSTGRESQL · SUPABASE · SQL · AUTHORIZATION · DATA MODELING
10 / API & INTEGRATION LAYER
Service layer that gives clients predictable contracts for calculations, records and external integrations.
Keeps domain rules isolated from transport concerns while preserving validation and useful error context.
NODE.JS · TYPESCRIPT · REST · VALIDATION · INTEGRATIONS
11 / DESKTOP AUTOMATION
C# services and utilities for workflows that need strong Windows integration or desktop execution.
Bridges local operations with APIs and structured data while keeping failure states visible.
C# · .NET · WINDOWS · APIS · AUTOMATION
12 / RUBY TOOLING
Ruby scripts and lightweight tools for clear, maintainable automation around recurring developer tasks.
Optimized for readable code, quick feedback and practical integration with existing workflows.
RUBY · SCRIPTING · AUTOMATION · DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE
13 / QUALITY PIPELINE
Layered verification across domain logic, APIs and complete browser flows for confidence during change.
Balances fast unit feedback with realistic integration and end-to-end coverage for critical paths.
VITEST · PLAYWRIGHT · UNIT · INTEGRATION · E2E · CI
14 / PRODUCTION DELIVERY
Repeatable delivery workflow covering local environments, containers, automated checks and web deployment.
Treats deployability, rollback awareness and operational clarity as part of product engineering.
DOCKER · CI/CD · VERCEL · ENVIRONMENTS · RELEASE DISCIPLINE
15 / DOCUMENTATION SYSTEM
Living technical documentation for architecture, setup, testing, deployment and operational decisions.
Shortens onboarding and makes production knowledge easier to verify, update and reuse.
ARCHITECTURE · RUNBOOKS · TESTING · DEPLOYMENT · DECISION RECORDS
